def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate tau_filter is not boolean
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")

    # Validate tau_filter is finite and nonnegative
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")

    # Validate each input matrix is a nonempty 2D numpy array
    for arr, name in [
        (logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
        (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
        (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call"),
    ]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be nonempty")

    # Validate shape consistency
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")

    # Validate all values are finite and nonpositive
    for arr, name in [
        (logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
        (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
        (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call"),
    ]:
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = shape

    # Compute normalized decreasing future-token weights (T01)
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Compute weighted future-token losses (T02)
    L_plus = -np.sum(logp_with_result * norm_weights, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(logp_call_only * norm_weights, axis=1)
    L_no_call = -np.sum(logp_no_call * norm_weights, axis=1)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline (T03)
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)

    # Keep calls meeting filtering threshold (T04)
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep_mask = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep_mask, margin
